chunks: From him, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, raising it, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who sprinkles salt upon the first morsel of his meal, the blemishes will go away from his face.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of putting salt on the first bite of food according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal virtue of salt, specifically noting that sprinkling it on the first bite of food prevents 'binamash' (small facial blemishes). This narration reflects the broader Shia tradition of linking prophetic dietary practices to physical well-being, emphasizing the holistic nature of health in Islamic teachings where simple foods like salt are viewed as divine remedies.
